title: Can AI answer the $3 trillion question?
slides: Can AI solve the trillion-dollar value-at-risk riddle?
One model just cracked market tail-risk predictions.
Humans guided it—until it found its own pattern.
Your risk team now faces a competitor that thinks differently.
Run a blind test on your VaR model today.
thread_text:
1. The model saw what we missed.

It predicted a market crash three days before the indexes moved. No human flagged it.

2. They trained it on tail risk — then it pivoted.

After 10,000 simulations, the AI abandoned human logic and invented its own correlation matrix.

3. Your VaR is blind to this pattern.

Your current model assumes Gaussian distributions. This one found a hidden fractal in volatility clusters.

4. A competitor already runs it.

One hedge fund deployed this model last quarter. Their risk-weighted return jumped 18%.

5. Run a blind test this week.

Take your VaR output and compare it against a free AI simulation. If it disagrees, ask yourself which one you trust.
